Class RawHttpClientSupport

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.RawHttpClientSupport
@Internal public final class RawHttpClientSupport extends Object
Shared implementation of RawRequestOptions and ProxyHttpClient for the HTTP client implementations.

  • Method Details

    • copyRequest

      public static MutableHttpRequest<Object> copyRequest(HttpRequest<?> request, RawRequestOptions options)
      Copy the metadata (method, URI, headers and attributes) of a request that is sent with options, so that the options can be applied without changing the given request. Like HttpRequest.toMutableRequest(), the copy has the attributes of the request, e.g. for the client filters. The body is not copied.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      options - The options
      Returns:
      The copy

    • toMutableResponse

      Returns:

    • withResponseTimeout

      public static ExecutionFlow<HttpResponse<?>> withResponseTimeout(ExecutionFlow<HttpResponse<?>> flow, @Nullable Duration timeout)
      Fail the given response flow with a ReadTimeoutException if it does not complete in time. A response that arrives after the timeout, or after the returned flow was cancelled, is closed. Cancelling the returned flow cancels the given one.
      Parameters:
      flow - The response flow
      timeout - The timeout, or null for none
      Returns:
      The flow with the timeout applied

    • claimServerRequestBody

      public static @Nullable CloseableByteBody claimServerRequestBody(HttpRequest<?> request)
      Claim the body bytes of the server request that the given request is, or wraps, e.g. a request a server filter mutated to proxy it. The bytes are only claimed if the body of the given request was not replaced.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      Returns:
      The body bytes, or null if the request is not a server request or its body was replaced
